title: A Systematic Study of Cross-Token Transfer for Data-Efficient Non-Verbal Text-to-Speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.19145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-verbal vocalizations (NVs), such as laughter and breath, carry affective cues that words alone do not convey. Yet NV data remains scarce because speech annotation pipelines often omit or normalize these events. Existing work has improved NV text-to-speech through model design and data curation, but whether one NV token can help a model learn another has received little systematic study. We investigate this cross-token transferability in a controlled CosyVoice 2 setup. We first trace a laughter-only scaling curve, then hold laughter at 200 or 1,600 examples while adding breath, sigh, cough, lip-smack, or neutral speech. With only 200 laughter examples, adding 3,200 cough examples raises end-to-end laughter F1 from 0.170 to 0.529, surpassing the 0.495 obtained from 1,600 laughter examples alone. translated_title: 面向数据高效非言语语音合成的跨词元迁移系统性研究
translated_abstract: 非言语发声（NVs），如笑声和呼吸声，携带着仅凭言语无法传达的情感线索。然而，由于语音标注流程常常忽略或规范化处理这些事件，NV数据仍然稀缺。现有工作通过模型设计和数据整理改进了NV文本转语音，但一种NV词元能否帮助模型学习另一种NV词元，尚未得到系统性研究。我们在受控的CosyVoice 2设置中研究了这种跨词元可迁移性。我们首先追踪了仅使用笑声数据的扩展曲线，然后在将笑声样本数固定为200或1,600的情况下，添加呼吸、叹气、咳嗽、咂嘴或中性语音数据。仅使用200个笑声样本时，添加3,200个咳嗽样本可将端到端笑声F1分数从0.170提升至0.529，超过了仅使用1,600个笑声样本所获得的0.495。在1,600个样本的基准下，添加咳嗽样本可达到0.695，几乎匹配6,400个笑声样本的效果（0.697）。波形级别的Whisper-D评分和语义（摘要内容被截断）
tldr: 该研究发现非言语发声词元之间存在显著的跨词元迁移效应——仅需200个笑声样本加上3,200个咳嗽样本，就能超越单独使用1,600个笑声样本的笑声合成效果，为数据高效的非言语语音合成提供了新路径。
en_tdlr: This study reveals significant cross-token transferability among non-verbal vocalizations: adding 3,200 cough examples to just 200 laughter examples surpasses the performance of training with 1,600 laughter examples alone, enabling data-efficient non-verbal text-to-speech.
